description: This file contains a sample Android activity demonstrating the use of MediaProjection API for screen capturing and sharing. It includes UI components for selecting resolution and toggling screen sharing, as well as lifecycle management for media projection and virtual displays.

classes.name: MediaProjectionDemo
classes.description: Main activity class that manages screen projection, virtual display creation, user interactions, and lifecycle events for media sharing.

classes.name: Resolution
classes.description: A helper class representing a screen resolution (width x height) and used within the resolution selection UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, measurement units, and resolution options.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Handles activity stopping, specifically stopping screen sharing.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up media projection resources upon activity destruction.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from permission request for screen capture, initializes MediaProjection, and creates virtual display.

methods.name: onToggleScreenShare
methods.description: Triggered by toggle button to start or stop screen sharing.

methods.name: shareScreen
methods.description: Starts the screen sharing process by creating virtual display if permissions are granted.

methods.name: stopScreenSharing
methods.description: Stops the screen sharing process, releasing virtual display and updating UI.

methods.name: createVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Creates a virtual display linked to MediaProjection for screen capturing.

methods.name: resizeVirtualDisplay
methods.description: Adjusts the resolution of the existing virtual display if necessary.
